candidates.change_summary: Return a different constant bytes32 value instead of ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Return keccak256 of a string instead of ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Remove the notDelegated modifier check, making the function return true unconditionally.
Replace `$._initialized == 0 && isTopLevelCall` with `$._initialized == 0` to allow initialization when not a top-level call.
Delete the entire `if (!initialSetup && !construction) { revert InvalidInitialization(); }` check, allowing re-initialization.
Replace `$._initialized = 1;` with `$._initialized = 2;` so the version stored after initializer changes.
Replace `emit Initialized(1);` with `emit Initialized(2);` so the event emitted differs.
Replace `__Access_init(_accessControl);` with `__Access_init(address(0));` so the access control address stored is different after initialization.
Delete `__UUPSUpgradeable_init();` so UUPS state is not initialized.
